confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Cebu pricing; no live listings, booking pages or price sources were inspected. Restaurant and beer anchors are moderately reliable; accommodation anchors vary widely by district and season, so they are less certain. Cocktail and wine_glass were not directly known and were set at roughly 2.5 to 3 times the beer anchor. The FX figure is the RBA observation dated 2026-10-13 found via search; any 14 or 15 October observation could not be verified.
comparable_city_reasoning: Reasoned from other mid-sized Philippine urban and tourist centers such as Davao and Iloilo, with Cebu priced below Metro Manila; holistic estimate, not drawn from specific listings.
